title: 6.10 Town Mission
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Follow a short visual route by identifying a destination, choosing transport, asking for help, following directions, and checking a schedule.
grammar_function: Integrated controlled navigation; no free map drawing, word ordering, or unconstrained conversation.
prerequisite: 6.9 review readiness met or targeted review completed.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six route-critical utterances spanning where, location, directions, ability, help, and schedule.

cards.pedagogy_note: Mission orientation; Find is already established as lesson-direction language in Unit 1.
Mission orientation retrieves known transport words instead of introducing procedural vocabulary.
